formats.key: mint(address collateralToken, uint256 collateralAmount, uint256 txDeadline, uint256 minFtUSDOut)
effects: Pulls collateralAmount of collateralToken from the signer (transferFrom, spends the signer's allowance to this contract) and deposits it into the collateral's yield wrapper.

Mints ftUSD at the oracle price (capped by the mint hardcap), keeps a mint fee in ftUSD, and sends the net ftUSD (at least minFtUSDOut) to the signer, either directly or through the payout router, which rate-limits payouts.
Reverts after txDeadline unless txDeadline is 0, which means no deadline.
formats.shown: Buy ftUSD: pay collateralAmount of the collateral token, receive at least minFtUSDOut ftUSD, before the deadline; the sentence reads 'Buy <min> ftUSD'.

findings.title: mint interpolatedIntent shows the minimum as the exact amount bought and leaves out the payment.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Buy {minFtUSDOut}"; case 0 renders "Buy 4.968328 ftUSD". MintAndRedeem.sol mintTo: `if (ftUSDAmount < minFtUSDOut) revert` means the signer gets at least this amount and usually more. The 4.994694 USDC payment appears only in the 'Pay' field.

findings.title: mint Deadline of 0 means no deadline, but the screen shows it as a 1970 date.
findings.evidence: MintAndRedeem.sol _enforceDeadline: `if (txDeadline == 0) return;`; descriptor field txDeadline format date, encoding timestamp, with no special-value handling.
findings.fix: Add a label or message for 0 ("No deadline") if the spec allows it, or note it in the label.

findings.title: mint can route ftUSD through a rate-limiting payout router, so delivery may be delayed or queued.
findings.evidence: MintAndRedeem.sol _executeMintWithRelayerFee: `if (address(router) != address(0)) { ...safeTransfer(address(router), netFtUSDAmount); router.payout(recipient, netToRecipient, executor, relayerFeeFtUSDAmount); }`. The router address comes from storage, and its source is not in the directory (the interface declares MintQueued).
findings.fix: If payouts can be queued, say in the intent that ftUSD may arrive later.

formats.key: redeem(address collateralToken, uint256 ftUSDAmount, uint256 txDeadline, uint256 minCollateralOut)
effects: Pulls ftUSDAmount of ftUSD from the signer (transferFrom, spends the signer's allowance to this contract).
Keeps a redeem fee in ftUSD and burns the rest.

Sends at least minCollateralOut of collateralToken to the signer through yieldWrapper.withdraw. The wrapper rate-limits outflows and returns a queueId, so the collateral may be queued instead of paid in this transaction.
Reverts after txDeadline unless txDeadline is 0, which means no deadline.
formats.shown: Sell ftUSD: pay ftUSDAmount ftUSD, receive at least minCollateralOut of the collateral token, before the deadline; the sentence reads 'Sell <amount> ftUSD'.

findings.title: redeem interpolatedIntent leaves out the collateral the signer receives.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Sell {ftUSDAmount}"; case 1 renders "Sell 8.438969 ftUSD". The 8.398031 USDC appears only in the 'Minimum receive' field.

findings.title: redeem collateral may be queued by the yield wrapper rather than delivered now, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: MintAndRedeem.sol _executeRedeemWithRelayerFee: `queueIdTo = wrapper.withdraw(collateralToRecipient, p.recipient);` with the comment "it handles rate limiting of collateral outflows". redeem returns (collateralAmount, queueId). The descriptor only shows 'Minimum receive'.
findings.fix: Say in the intent or a label that the collateral may be queued for later withdrawal (e.g. "Minimum receive (may be queued)").

findings.title: redeem Deadline of 0 means no deadline, but the screen shows it as a 1970 date.
findings.evidence: MintAndRedeem.sol _enforceDeadline: `if (txDeadline == 0) return;`; descriptor field txDeadline format date, with no special-value handling.

couldNotCheck: Per-collateral yield wrapper (IftYieldWrapperV2, address in storage, source not in directory): its withdraw() decides whether redeem pays the signer's collateral now or queues it.
Payout router (IMintPayoutRouter, address in storage, source not in directory): its payout() decides whether and when mint delivers the signer's ftUSD.
